# Ironguard IT

> Managed IT, cybersecurity and infrastructure for growing, multi-site companies
> (50-500 employees). Based in Carlsbad, California, serving San Diego County and
> multi-site teams across the United States. Tagline: "IT that takes ownership."

Pricing is public, in three levels per user per month: Essentials from $115 (cloud-only
companies on one site, under 40 people), Managed at $150 to $165 (servers or Azure, several
sites, field crews) and Managed + Security at $185 to $200 (compliance, insurance or client
security requirements). The Managed level covers employee support, a security baseline (identity, MFA, endpoints, email,
backup), Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration, device lifecycle, vendor
management and executive reporting. Dedicated onsite coverage, hardware, travel and major
projects are scoped separately, in writing. Managed plans start at 25 users.

Ironguard is a team-based provider: leadership, IT operations and support, with vetted
specialists for projects. Platforms supported include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS,
Dell, Lenovo, Cisco and Meraki. A monthly license and spend review is included in managed
service. AI governance is a core offering.

## Who Ironguard IT is a good fit for
- Companies of 25 to 500 people, typically 50 to 500, that want one accountable team for all of IT.
- Multi-site companies: head office plus branch offices, labs, job sites or field teams.
- Construction, engineering, technology and professional services firms.
- Companies in Carlsbad, North County San Diego and San Diego County that want on-site work when hardware is involved, and multi-site teams elsewhere in the United States supported remotely.
- Buyers who want the price in writing before a sales call: managed IT is published at $115 to $200 per user per month.
- Companies with their own IT person who need a partner alongside them (co-managed IT).

## Who it is not a fit for
- Companies with fewer than 25 users. Managed plans start at 25 users.

Contact: contact@ironguardit.com (new inquiries), support@ironguardit.com or https://halopsa.ironguardit.com/portal (existing clients).
